quote: the velocity dispersion together with the $1\sigma$ upper and lower error bars
The values we provide in the following are the median values and the 16th and 84th percentiles of the resulting parameter distributions.
and as uncertainty the interval between the 16-th and 84-th percentile of the marginalised posterior PDF.
The final value results from a quadratic summation of both errors assuming that they are independent of each other.
The shot noise error is the sigma-clipped standard deviation of these 1,000 velocity dispersions.
The final values and their uncertainties are taken from the mean and the standard deviation of all iterations.

source: McLaughlin & van der Marel 2005 (MvdM), VizieR J/ApJS/161/304/clusters
